title: The Last Lighthouse (2/3): Into The Storm

scenes.narration: Last night, a light blinked out of the storm. S O S. Child on board. Then... it went dark.
Your rowboat hasn't left the rock in three years. Tonight... it's going to have to.
scenes.visual: rowboat tied at the rocks, storm

scenes.narration: Pepper jumps in before you can stop her. She hates the water. She hates storms. But she hates being left behind more.
You row. The waves are taller than the lighthouse door. Your hands are bleeding. You keep rowing.
Lightning. And for one second... you see it. A sailboat. Tipped on its side.
A girl is clinging to the mast. Yellow raincoat. Maybe ten years old.
You grab her arm. Her name is Juno. She keeps saying the same thing... Dad steered for the light. Dad steered for the light.
Her dad isn't on the boat.
You turn back. Every stroke, you watch the lighthouse beam. It's the only way home.
The generator. Three years, it never failed once. And it picks tonight.
You make it to the rocks. Barely. Juno is shivering. Pepper hasn't left her lap for a second.
scenes.visual: on the rocks, cat on the girl's lap

scenes.narration: Then Juno points at the horizon... and goes very quiet.
Lights. Dozens of them. Boats. All of them... heading straight for the rocks.
scenes.visual: many boat lights on the horizon

scenes.narration: They saw your light. For three years, they saw it. And now it's gone. How would you save them? Comment below... part three is up next.
scenes.visual: end card: HOW WOULD YOU SAVE THEM?
